# CG-RES-027: Response body added

A response that had no body now has one.

**Why it matters:** Additional content does not invalidate existing handling.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Responses](./#res) |
| Detects | `response.bodyAdded` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: low · undetermined: low |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> A body was added to {where}.
>
> Existing consumers ignore a body they did not expect.
>
> **Fix:** No action needed.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: existing 200 gains content

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {}}}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. A body was added to GET /x: response 200.

### Does not fire: body on both sides

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
        responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml
rules:
  ignore:
    - rule: CG-RES-027
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:
    CG-RES-027: { severity: low }
```
